verdict.rationale: LangSmith explicitly documents annotation queues and inline annotation for gathering human feedback/labeling on outputs (langsmith-docs-5), and human review is listed as one of its evaluator types alongside code rules and LLM-as-judge (langsmith-docs-8/21/26), supporting routing outputs for human review and labeling as part of the evals-datasets workflow. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on account of using annotation queues specifically, and no detail on queue assignment/workflow mechanics beyond the docs mention.
